# Planium Pro

> Planium Pro is a cloud-based strategic planning and financial forecasting software that integrates with major accounting platforms to help businesses, advisors, and students create comprehensive business plans.

Planium Pro, developed by Levant Software Technology Pty Ltd in Brisbane, Australia, offers tiered membership plans (Lite and Professional) with strategic analysis frameworks like SWOT, Five Forces, and PESTEL analysis. The platform serves SMEs, entrepreneurs, professional advisors, academics, and students with integrated planning and reporting capabilities.
